title: [NatWest demo] Payments audit - excessive declines by tier
description: Counts payment declines, throttles and errors in index=nwpay_audit grouped by customer_tier over the last 5 minutes. Fires one ITSI notable event when any one tier exceeds 20 affected payments in the window. Pairs with the Splunk Observability detector '[NatWest demo] Bronze tier decline rate' to give Episode Review two independent signals on the same underlying chaos (incident.sh inject-tier-throttle bronze): one from spans, one from the banking audit pipeline. The dedupe key (cohort_key) collapses repeated firings on the same tier inside the same Episode so the on-call sees one ticket, not five.
search: index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" decision IN ("rejected","throttled","error") | bin _time span=5m | stats count as declines, dc(customer_id_hash) as customers, values(decline_reason) as reasons by _time, customer_tier | where declines > 20 | eval severity = case(declines > 100, "6", declines > 50, "5", true(), "4") | eval service = "Customer Tier Experience" | eval title = "Excessive declines for " . customer_tier . " tier (" . declines . " payments / " . customers . " customers)" | eval cohort_key = "declines:" . customer_tier . ":" . strftime(_time, "%Y%m%d%H%M") | eval source = "Splunk ES - payments audit" | eval description = title . " - reasons: " . mvjoin(reasons, ", ") | eval service_ids = "nwpay_l2_customer_tier_experience,nwpay_l2_dce,nwpay_l2_payment" | table _time, severity, service, service_ids, title, source, customer_tier, declines, customers, reasons, cohort_key, description
action.itsi_event_generator.param.title: $result.title$
